description: Aeroportos Públicos no Estado de São Paulo - ANAC 2021 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Localização dos aeroportos públicos existentes no Estado de São Paulo, definido a partir do centro geométrico da maior pista. Nos aeroportos públicos, são autorizados a exploração comercial do transporte aéreo de passageiros e/ou cargas de tipo de uso público, e seu cadastramento pela ANAC é denominado homologação. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Aeródromo, aeródromo, aerodromo, Aeroporto, aeroporto. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
